blocks.text: She wants to keep history alive. Yunna Kinereish, 22, is studying public relations in Kazakhstan’s modern capital, Astana. She describes herself as a Kazakh German. “I am German by ethnicity. But I also feel that I’m Kazakh, because I keep the traditions with my family, and I have this mentality,” she told DW. Kinereish, who belongs to the Wiedergeburt (Revival) Association of Germans in Kazakhstan, is one of 223,000 Kazakh Germans living in the Central Asian republic of Kazakhstan today.
